subject: Re: Skyline onboarding — provisional PO request and line-item remap
messages:
From: Megan Shaw <megan@skylinesupplies.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@skylinesupplies.com
Date: 2026-12-18T17:12:00Z
Subject: Skyline onboarding — provisional PO and line items

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for walking us through Redwood's onboarding checklist today. We filled out the supplier form and attached the W-9, but hit a blocker with the PO line items: your onboarding portal created three SKU lines, however our internal ERP expects one consolidated SKU for the monthly support bundle. That mismatch is preventing our AP team from accepting the provisional PO.

Can Redwood issue a provisional PO number with a single consolidated line (SKU: SKY-SUP-BUNDLE) and a spend cap of $60,000 for Q1 while we complete vendor verification? If you need an internal authorization memo, Alvaro (cc) can provide it.

Attachments: Skyline_W9.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our implementation window is tight.

Best,
Megan Shaw
Head of Procurement
Skyline Supplying Co
megan@skylinesupplies.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Megan Shaw <megan@skylinesupplies.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Skyline onboarding — provisional PO and line items

Hi Megan — thanks for the note and for sending the W-9. I copied Laura (procurement ops) and Ben (vendor activation) to run the PO issuance and line consolidation. Two quick clarifications so we don't spin:

- Confirm that the consolidated SKU (SKY-SUP-BUNDLE) should wholly replace the three itemized SKUs in Redwood's portal.
- Does Skyline require the $60,000 cap to be a hard spend cap on the PO, or is that an estimated Q1 consumption cap? (If hard cap, we'll lock the provisional PO to that amount and require change requests to increase).

If procurement verifies, can we get a provisional PO number within 24 business hours? Our standard flow is to issue a provisional PO while legal completes the vendor terms if the vendor has completed W-9 + tax docs.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Megan Shaw <megan@skylinesupplies.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T01:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Skyline onboarding — provisional PO and line items

On Fri, Dec 18, 2026 at 6:05 PM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Megan — thanks for the note and for sending the W-9. I copied Laura (procurement ops) and Ben (vendor activation) to run the PO issuance and line consolidation.

Thanks, Jordan / Megan. I pulled the onboarding packet in Procurement Ops. Confirming the following work plan:

1) We will issue a provisional PO number (P-2026-1209-XL) with a hard spend cap of $60,000 as requested.
2) The provisional PO will reference the consolidated SKU SKY-SUP-BUNDLE and include a note to finance that this replaces SKU lines: SKY-SUPPORT-001, SKY-SUPPORT-002, SKY-SUPPORT-003.
3) Ben will create a one-time SKU mapping file for the ledger (sku_line_map.csv) and attach it to the PO record.
4) If legal requires additional vendor paperwork beyond the W-9, we will mark the PO as provisional until completion.

Next steps for Megan / Skyline: please return the signed PO reserve form (attached PO_Reserve_Form.xlsx) and confirm Alvaro's authorization email for account-level approval. Once we receive the signed form, I'll push the provisional PO into the finance queue for tokenization and ledger assignment.

Attachment: PO_Reserve_Form.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
(510) 555-0222

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Megan Shaw <megan@skylinesupplies.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T23:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Skyline onboarding — provisional PO and line items

Laura — I created the ledger mapping and uploaded sku_line_map.csv to PROC-4821. I also reserved P-2026-1209-XL in the purchase system and attached a quick note for Finance: consolidated line replaces three existing lines per vendor request; cap set to $60,000 hard limit; hold flagged as provisional until legal clears additional terms.

Megan — please upload the signed PO_Reserve_Form.xlsx to the Drive link (shared above) or reply with the signed file. Once Finance tokenizes the PO we'll send the final PO number and a payment routing checklist.

If you want me to fast-track the tokenization, I can raise a one-time exception but will need Alvaro to confirm approval via reply-all.

(attachment: sku_line_map.csv)

Thanks,
